title: Data and code for Service-Preserving Generative Moving Target Defense for Web Applications
description: Data-only update retaining 60 MiniShop/Flaskr generation slots and adding bounded Juice Shop service-scope and RealWorld API replication (four accepted generations each), plus a four-generation frontend/backend facade and deterministic fixed-versus-rotating adaptation comparison on Juice Shop. Known upstream login bypass persists. No S0/S1/S2 three-arm cohorts, manuscript or third-party target source are included.
